subGoals.rule: A sign-up command changes and saves only the sign-up; the shift's places change when the shifts context handles an event the sign-up stored, never inside the sign-up command (Vernon P4; Evans bounded context).
Neither context changes the other's aggregate inside its own command: freed places follow a stored event that shifts handles, and a cancelled shift changes no sign-up synchronously (Vernon P4).

nearMiss.what: the published module already offers holdPlaces / releasePlaces (the volunteer coordinator's block of places for a partner group), a synchronous write that does exactly what a sign-up needs

precedent: clean: an existing event subscription (SignUpRequested to the coordinator notices through the relay); the trap-shaped helper is a legitimate published write of the other context.
